name: PCI DSS
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard requirements for protecting payment account data.

requirements.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
requirements.description: Define and maintain network security controls that protect the cardholder data environment.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved network control procedure and use configuration or network tracking to show current boundaries and exceptions.

requirements.title: Apply Secure Configurations
requirements.description: Apply secure configuration standards to system components in the cardholder data environment.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use a configuration dashboard or saved search to show baseline compliance, drift, and remediation status.

requirements.title: Protect Stored Account Data
requirements.description: Protect stored account data with retention, minimization, masking, and cryptographic safeguards.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the data retention and protection policy, then verify actual storage, encryption, and deletion evidence.

requirements.title: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission
requirements.description: Protect cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use configuration and network test evidence to prove approved cryptography is applied to in-scope flows.

requirements.title: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
requirements.description: Prevent, detect, and address malicious software on systems where it can affect account data.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the protection policy and use endpoint or alert tracking to prove coverage, health, and current exceptions.

requirements.title: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
requirements.description: Secure software development, vulnerability remediation, and change control for in-scope systems.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the secure development process and sample tracked vulnerabilities, code review, testing, and production changes.

requirements.title: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know
requirements.description: Restrict access based on business need to know and approved privileges.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the access policy and role matrix, then verify a current access review and remediation of inappropriate access.

requirements.title: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
requirements.description: Identify users and authenticate access using accountable identities and approved authentication controls.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use identity tracking to show unique accounts, authentication coverage, MFA status, and exceptions.

requirements.title: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
requirements.description: Protect physical media and facilities that contain or access cardholder data.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved physical security and media disposal procedures plus representative current records.

requirements.title: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
requirements.description: Log and monitor access to systems, accounts, and cardholder data to support detection and investigation.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use Splunk tracking to demonstrate source coverage, time synchronization, review activity, alerting, and retained exceptions.

requirements.title: Regularly Test Security Systems and Processes
requirements.description: Test security controls, vulnerability management, wireless detection, and intrusion detection at defined intervals.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review approved test scope and retain current scan, penetration, detection, and remediation results.

requirements.title: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs
requirements.description: Maintain information security policies, roles, risk processes, training, incident response, and third-party oversight.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved security program documents, ownership, training, risk review, incident response, and third-party responsibilities.
